# Flip

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Mirrors a native subtree about its box centre without changing flow dimensions.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IContentContainer`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Flip(options?: FlipOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`child`](#child): The native subtree to transform.
- [`contentWidth`](#contentwidth): Optional positive child width before transformation, in points.
- [`horizontal`](#horizontal): Mirror left and right about the child box centre.
- [`vertical`](#vertical): Mirror top and bottom about the child box centre.
